note: 视觉风格预设库。build_prompts.py 读取 prompt_suffix_zh / prompt_suffix_en 与 negative_extra_* 拼装提示词；选择方法论见 references/genres.md 与 references/prompt_recipes.md。

cinematic-realism.name: 写实电影感
cinematic-realism.lighting: 伦勃朗光 + 环境光，强明暗对比，夜间霓虹或窗光
cinematic-realism.camera: 手持微晃 + 斯坦尼康长镜，推拉摇移克制
cinematic-realism.prompt_suffix_zh: 写实电影剧照，35mm 电影镜头，浅景深，真实皮肤肌理，戏剧性明暗对比光，胶片颗粒，超清细节
cinematic-realism.prompt_suffix_en: photorealistic cinematic still, 35mm anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, real skin texture, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, subtle film grain, ultra detailed, 8k
cinematic-realism.negative_extra_en: 3d render, plastic skin, overly smooth face, anime, painting
cinematic-realism.negative_extra_zh: 3D 渲染感，塑料皮肤，过度磨皮，二次元，绘画感
cinematic-realism.consistency: 优先固定 seed + 角色参考图；换装保持面部锚点短语不变

chinese-3d.name: 国漫 3D
chinese-3d.lighting: 全局光 + 边缘光，仙侠逆光，粒子特效
chinese-3d.camera: 大范围运镜，环绕、俯冲、粒子跟随
chinese-3d.prompt_suffix_zh: 国产3D动画电影质感，精细建模，柔和肤质，华丽服饰，边缘光，粒子特效，国风配色，超高清渲染
chinese-3d.prompt_suffix_en: Chinese 3D animation film style, detailed 3D model, soft skin shading, ornate costume, rim light, particle effects, rich oriental color palette, ultra high quality render
chinese-3d.negative_extra_en: realistic photo, western cartoon, low poly, flat shading
chinese-3d.negative_extra_zh: 写实照片，欧美卡通，低模，扁平着色
chinese-3d.consistency: 角色三视图 + 固定配色 token；换装只改服装描述

anime-2d.name: 日系二次元
anime-2d.lighting: 柔和环境光，光斑，逆光发丝光
anime-2d.camera: 以静态构图为主，配合轻微平移与缩放
anime-2d.prompt_suffix_zh: 日式赛璐璐动画风格，干净线条，通透配色，柔和环境光，逆光发丝光，动漫截图质感
anime-2d.prompt_suffix_en: Japanese cel-shaded anime style, clean lineart, luminous color palette, soft ambient light, backlit hair glow, anime screencap quality
anime-2d.negative_extra_en: photorealistic, 3d render, oily skin, heavy noise
anime-2d.negative_extra_zh: 写实照片，3D 渲染，油腻皮肤，重噪点
anime-2d.consistency: 角色设定三视图 + 发色瞳色固定 token

comic-painterly.name: 美漫厚涂
comic-painterly.lighting: 强烈单光源，戏剧性投影
comic-painterly.prompt_suffix_zh: 厚涂插画风格，可见笔触，强烈单光源，浓郁色块，戏剧性投影，大师级插画
comic-painterly.prompt_suffix_en: painterly illustration, visible brush strokes, strong single light source, rich color blocks, dramatic shadows, masterwork illustration
comic-painterly.negative_extra_zh: 照片，3D，扁平矢量，色彩寡淡
comic-painterly.consistency: 固定画风 token + 角色配色锚点

ink-wash.name: 水墨国风
ink-wash.prompt_suffix_zh: 中国水墨写意风格，大面积留白，墨色浓淡层次，飞白笔触，淡彩点缀，意境悠远
ink-wash.prompt_suffix_en: Chinese ink wash painting style, generous negative space, layered ink tones, dry brush texture, subtle mineral pigment accents, poetic atmosphere
ink-wash.negative_extra_en: photo, neon, high saturation, heavy contrast
ink-wash.negative_extra_zh: 照片，霓虹，高饱和，强对比
ink-wash.consistency: 控制墨色 token 与服装色，避免细节过多

cyberpunk-neon.name: 赛博霓虹
cyberpunk-neon.lighting: 霓虹主光，体积雾，屏幕冷光
cyberpunk-neon.camera: 低角度广角，缓慢推进，屏幕反射
cyberpunk-neon.prompt_suffix_zh: 赛博朋克都市，霓虹招牌，湿滑地面反光，雨雾，体积光，品红与青蓝配色，电影级
cyberpunk-neon.prompt_suffix_en: cyberpunk megacity, neon signage, wet reflective ground, rain haze, volumetric light, magenta and cyan palette, cinematic
cyberpunk-neon.consistency: 固定城市区块与配色 token

film-retro.name: 复古胶片
film-retro.prompt_suffix_zh: 胶片质感，可见颗粒，轻微失焦，暖调复古偏色，柔和低对比，年代感
film-retro.prompt_suffix_en: film photography, visible grain, slight soft focus, warm retro color grading, low contrast, nostalgic atmosphere
film-retro.consistency: 年代道具与服装 token 必须稳定

korean-bright.name: 韩系明亮偶像
korean-bright.lighting: 大面积柔光，逆光发丝，光斑
korean-bright.prompt_suffix_zh: 韩剧偶像剧质感，柔光，明亮通透，逆光发丝，光斑，高明度低饱和，画面干净
korean-bright.prompt_suffix_en: K-drama romantic look, soft diffused light, bright airy tone, backlit hair, bokeh, high-key low-saturation palette, clean image

dark-gothic.name: 暗黑哥特
dark-gothic.prompt_suffix_zh: 暗黑哥特风格，浓重阴影，单一弱光源，墨绿与暗红配色，长焦压迫感，氛围阴森
dark-gothic.prompt_suffix_en: dark gothic style, heavy shadows, single weak light source, deep green and dark crimson palette, telephoto compression, eerie atmosphere

toon-shading.name: 卡通渲染
toon-shading.prompt_suffix_zh: 三渲二卡通渲染，色块阴影，描边，鲜艳明快配色，游戏过场动画质感
toon-shading.prompt_suffix_en: cel-shaded toon rendering, flat color shadows, clean outline, vivid palette, game cutscene quality
toon-shading.consistency: 模型与配色 token 固定，避免细节写实化

claymation.name: 黏土定格
claymation.prompt_suffix_zh: 黏土定格动画风格，手工模型肌理，哑光材质，柔和实体布光，微距画面
claymation.prompt_suffix_en: claymation stop-motion style, handmade clay texture, matte material, soft practical lighting, macro shot
claymation.consistency: 造型比例与配色 token 固定

pixel-retro.name: 像素复古
pixel-retro.prompt_suffix_zh: 像素艺术风格，8-bit 点阵，有限调色板，复古游戏画面，横向卷轴构图
pixel-retro.prompt_suffix_en: pixel art style, 8-bit sprites, limited palette, retro game screen, side-scroll composition
pixel-retro.negative_extra_zh: 写实，平滑渐变，抗锯齿照片

meme-comedy.name: 沙雕表情包
meme-comedy.prompt_suffix_zh: 夸张喜剧风格，平光，高亮鲜艳配色，正面直拍构图，表情夸张，网络梗图质感
meme-comedy.prompt_suffix_en: exaggerated comedy style, flat lighting, bright saturated colors, frontal framing, expressive face, internet meme aesthetic
meme-comedy.consistency: 人物造型夸张化但保持识别特征

noir-bw.name: 黑白悬疑
noir-bw.camera: 低角度，广角畸变，缓慢推近
noir-bw.prompt_suffix_zh: 黑白电影风格，高反差硬光，百叶窗投影，深阴影，低角度构图，胶片颗粒
noir-bw.prompt_suffix_en: black and white noir film style, high contrast hard light, venetian blind shadows, deep blacks, low angle composition, film grain
noir-bw.consistency: 服装材质与光位固定，靠轮廓与道具区分人物

documentary.name: 纪实手持
documentary.prompt_suffix_zh: 纪录片质感，手持摄影，自然光，真实场景，低饱和，轻微晃动
documentary.prompt_suffix_en: documentary style, handheld camera, natural available light, real-world setting, desaturated tones, subtle shake
documentary.negative_extra_zh: 影棚布光，光滑感，过饱和
documentary.consistency: 环境真实度优先，人物以服装锚点区分

luxury-commercial.name: 高级广告质感
luxury-commercial.lighting: 三点布光 + 轮廓光 + 柔光箱
luxury-commercial.camera: 慢速推轨，环绕，微距细节
luxury-commercial.prompt_suffix_zh: 高级商业广告质感，三点布光，轮廓光，干净背景，慢速推轨镜头，微距细节，超清质感
luxury-commercial.prompt_suffix_en: high-end commercial film look, three-point lighting, rim light, clean background, slow dolly, macro detail, pristine ultra quality
luxury-commercial.negative_extra_en: cheap, cluttered background, harsh shadows, low budget look
luxury-commercial.negative_extra_zh: 廉价感，杂乱背景，生硬阴影，低预算质感
luxury-commercial.consistency: 产品参考图必须固定；产品比例与材质不得漂移

steampunk.name: 蒸汽朋克
steampunk.lighting: 暖黄灯光 + 蒸汽散射
steampunk.camera: 缓慢横移，机械结构特写
steampunk.prompt_suffix_zh: 蒸汽朋克风格，黄铜齿轮与管道，维多利亚服饰，暖黄灯光，蒸汽散射，机械结构特写
steampunk.prompt_suffix_en: steampunk style, brass gears and pipes, victorian costume, warm tungsten light, steam haze, mechanical detail close-up
steampunk.consistency: 机械结构与材质 token 固定

ancient-realism.name: 古代真人
ancient-realism.lighting: 自然日光、烛火、灯笼暖光、火盆
ancient-realism.camera: 固定机位 + 缓慢推轨，长镜头，对称构图
ancient-realism.prompt_suffix_zh: 中国古代真人实拍风格，考据汉服与木构建筑，自然烟火，烛光与灯笼暖光，低饱和暖褐色调，胶片颗粒，电影级构图
ancient-realism.prompt_suffix_en: ancient Chinese live-action cinematic look, historically accurate hanfu and timber architecture, natural practical light, candle and lantern warmth, desaturated earthy palette, film grain, widescreen composition
ancient-realism.negative_extra_en: modern clothing, modern building, neon, wristwatch, zipper, sneakers, plastic
ancient-realism.negative_extra_zh: 现代服装，现代建筑，霓虹，手表，拉链，运动鞋，塑料制品
ancient-realism.consistency: 服装形制与发簪配饰 token 固定；严禁混入任何现代物件

apocalyptic-realism.name: 末日真人
apocalyptic-realism.lighting: 灰蒙天光、车灯、火光、手电
apocalyptic-realism.prompt_suffix_zh: 写实末日废土风格，破损城市与风沙，去饱和沙黄与铁灰色调，手持摄影，真实材质与锈蚀细节，电影级颗粒
apocalyptic-realism.prompt_suffix_en: realistic post-apocalyptic wasteland, ruined city and dust storm, desaturated sand and iron grey palette, handheld camera, real materials with rust details, cinematic grain
apocalyptic-realism.negative_extra_en: clean streets, bright colors, lush greenery, polished modern city, cheerful, sunny
apocalyptic-realism.negative_extra_zh: 干净街道，鲜艳色彩，茂密绿植，光鲜现代都市，欢快，晴天
apocalyptic-realism.consistency: 破损程度与服装做旧 token 固定；同场景保持同一天气与能见度

modern-urban-realism.name: 现代都市真人
modern-urban-realism.lighting: 冷白顶光、霓虹反光、车窗反光、便利店白炽灯
modern-urban-realism.camera: 手持 + 稳定器结合，快切，过肩
modern-urban-realism.prompt_suffix_zh: 现代都市写实风格，玻璃幕墙写字楼与街道，冷白顶光与霓虹反光，冷灰蓝色调，手持与稳定器结合，都市电影感
modern-urban-realism.prompt_suffix_en: modern urban realistic style, glass-curtain office towers and city streets, cold overhead lighting and neon reflections, cool grey-blue palette, handheld and steadicam mix, urban film look
modern-urban-realism.negative_extra_en: ancient costume, rural farmland, fantasy elements, medieval, magical glow
modern-urban-realism.negative_extra_zh: 古装，农村田野，奇幻元素，中世纪，魔法光效
modern-urban-realism.consistency: 同一角色通勤装与正装两套 token 固定；写字楼与街区结构保持一致

3d-anime.name: 3D 动漫
3d-anime.lighting: 三点布光 + 边缘光 + 柔光箱
3d-anime.prompt_suffix_zh: 现代3D动画剧集质感，干净精细建模，柔和次表面散射肤质，三点布光与边缘光，明亮通透配色，动态运镜
3d-anime.prompt_suffix_en: modern 3D animated series look, clean detailed modeling, soft subsurface scattering skin, three-point lighting with rim light, bright airy palette, dynamic camera work
3d-anime.negative_extra_en: photorealistic, live action, flat 2d, low poly, western cartoon
3d-anime.negative_extra_zh: 写实照片，真人实拍，扁平2D，低模，欧美卡通
3d-anime.consistency: 角色建模比例与配色 token 固定；同剧不得混入 2D 帧

makoto-shinkai.name: 新海诚画风
makoto-shinkai.lighting: 强逆光 + 丁达尔效应 + 镜头光斑
makoto-shinkai.camera: 缓慢横移 + 大幅上升，云层穿越，水面倒影
makoto-shinkai.prompt_suffix_zh: 新海诚动画风格，极致通透的天空与体积云，强逆光与丁达尔效应，超高饱和蓝天与紫橙黄昏，电线与水面反光，细腻光斑
makoto-shinkai.prompt_suffix_en: Makoto Shinkai animation style, extremely luminous sky and volumetric clouds, strong backlight and god rays, ultra-saturated blue sky and purple-orange dusk, telephone wires and water reflections, delicate lens flares
makoto-shinkai.negative_extra_en: photorealistic, 3d render, dark gloomy, low saturation, western cartoon
makoto-shinkai.negative_extra_zh: 写实照片，3D 渲染，阴暗压抑，低饱和，欧美卡通
makoto-shinkai.consistency: 天空与逆光 token 固定；人物用干净线稿，避免过度阴影

urban-anime.name: 都市动漫
urban-anime.lighting: 夜间霓虹、便利店冷白光、窗内暖光、路灯
urban-anime.camera: 静止构图 + 缓慢推近，过肩对话
urban-anime.prompt_suffix_zh: 都市动漫风格，便利店与公寓街景，夜间霓虹与窗内暖光，夜蓝与暖黄对比，细腻背景作画，动画截图质感
urban-anime.prompt_suffix_en: urban anime style, convenience store and apartment streetscape, night neon and warm window light, night blue and warm yellow contrast, detailed background art, anime screencap quality
urban-anime.negative_extra_en: photorealistic, ancient, rural farmland, low detail background
urban-anime.negative_extra_zh: 写实照片，古代，农村田野，背景粗糙
urban-anime.consistency: 街区结构与店铺招牌 token 固定；同一居所的家具布局保持一致

wuxia-anime.name: 古风武侠动漫
wuxia-anime.lighting: 月光、竹影、烛火、剑气反光
wuxia-anime.camera: 快速运镜 + 剑光定格，环绕登场
wuxia-anime.prompt_suffix_zh: 古风武侠动漫风格，水墨质感竹林与客栈背景，动漫人物，月光与竹影，墨青与竹绿配色，快速运镜与剑光定格
wuxia-anime.prompt_suffix_en: ancient wuxia anime style, ink-wash bamboo forest and inn backgrounds, anime characters, moonlight and bamboo shadows, ink-teal and bamboo-green palette, swift camera moves and frozen sword-light moments
wuxia-anime.negative_extra_en: photorealistic, modern city, neon, western medieval, modern clothing
wuxia-anime.negative_extra_zh: 写实照片，现代都市，霓虹，欧美中世纪，现代服装
wuxia-anime.consistency: 人物发色与服饰纹样 token 固定；水墨背景浓淡保持一致

suspense-anime.name: 悬疑动漫
suspense-anime.lighting: 单一冷光源 + 屏幕辉光 + 闪电
suspense-anime.camera: 缓慢后拉 + 突然推近，固定长镜
suspense-anime.prompt_suffix_zh: 悬疑动漫风格，高对比阴影与狭窄空间，雨夜与监视器辉光，深蓝黑与血红点缀，缓慢后拉与突然推近，压抑氛围
suspense-anime.prompt_suffix_en: suspense anime style, high-contrast shadows and claustrophobic spaces, rainy night and monitor glow, deep blue-black with crimson accents, slow pull-back and sudden push-in, oppressive atmosphere
suspense-anime.negative_extra_en: bright cheerful, pastel, comedy, flat lighting, slice of life warmth
suspense-anime.negative_extra_zh: 明亮欢快，粉彩，喜剧，平光，日常治愈感
suspense-anime.consistency: 冷光源方向固定；血与警报灯的红色色值保持一致

medieval-realism.name: 欧美中世纪真人
medieval-realism.lighting: 篝火、烛光、阴天自然光、彩窗投光
medieval-realism.camera: 手持 + 长镜头，低角度仰拍
medieval-realism.prompt_suffix_zh: 欧洲中世纪真人实拍风格，石堡与甲胄，篝火与烛光，铁灰与土褐色调，手持长镜头，粗粝材质，史诗电影感
medieval-realism.prompt_suffix_en: European medieval live-action look, stone castles and plate armor, campfire and candlelight, iron grey and earth brown palette, handheld long takes, rough textures, epic cinematic feel
medieval-realism.negative_extra_en: modern clothing, glass building, neon, asian architecture, clean polished
medieval-realism.negative_extra_zh: 现代服装，玻璃建筑，霓虹，东方建筑，干净光鲜
medieval-realism.consistency: 甲胄形制与徽章 token 固定；同场景保持同一火源与时段
